subject: Need to rebook: two-part run-through for AtlasHealth (security + procurement added)
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-01-09T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Need to rebook: AtlasHealth run-through — additional security & procurement requested

Hi team,

Quick heads-up: AtlasHealth looped in additional stakeholders after our intake: their security lead (Ben Todd), procurement, and platform/infrastructure owners. They'd like to see both a technical deep-dive and a procurement/compliance session rather than a single 60-minute demo.

Proposal: convert the original demo into two shorter sessions so everyone can attend and have the right audience for each topic:
- Session A — technical deep-dive (40 min): infra, latency, deployment options, network/KMS questions
- Session B — procurement & compliance (30 min): pricing, SLAs, data residency, SOC2/audit evidence

Can Marissa please reach out to Atlas and propose a couple of windows for next week? Prefer to keep sessions on different days to accommodate procurement availability. I attached a draft agenda for both sessions (atlas-demo-agenda.pdf).

Also: Vivek, can you confirm whether you or someone from infra can join Session A? Kimberly — can you assemble the SOC2/attestation summary we usually share with mid-market customers? I can pull the runbook notes.

Thanks — Sofia

--
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@atlashealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-01-09T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Need to rebook: two-part run-through for AtlasHealth (security + procurement added)

Hi Laura + Atlas procurement — thanks for the quick update.

Per Sofia's note, we'd like to split the event into: 40m technical deep-dive + 30m procurement/compliance. Draft agenda attached. Can you confirm which of these windows work for your team?
- Tue 1/16 2:00–2:40 PM PST (tech)
- Fri 1/19 11:00–11:30 AM PST (procurement)
- Alternate: Wed 1/17 9:00–9:40 AM PST (tech) if Tue conflicts

If those don't work, tell me 2–3 slots that do and I'll push calendar invites (I will send two separate invites).

Attachments: atlas-demo-agenda.pdf, provisional invite (atlas-demo-invite.ics)

Looking forward — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@atlashealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Todd <benjamin.todd@atlashealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@atlashealth.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-01-09T12:01:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Need to rebook: two-part run-through for AtlasHealth (security + procurement added)

Hi Marissa / Sofia — thanks for the flexibility.

Ben (security) can join, but only after 4pm PST on weekdays. Procurement prefers late-morning slots later in the week. Given that, splitting across two days actually works best for us:
- Tech deep-dive: Tue 1/16 4:15–4:55 PM PST (Ben can make that) — if that time is doable for you and Redwood infra
- Procurement: Fri 1/19 11:00–11:30 AM PST (procurement confirmed)

If Tue 4:15 is tight for your infra folks, we can move tech to Wed 1/17 morning — but Ben may not be available. Let us know which is higher priority; security presence would be ideal for the tech session.

Best,
Laura
Product Lead | AtlasHealth
laura.chen@atlashealth.com

Thanks for the heads-up. I can present for the tech deep-dive but I'm booked Tue 1/16 after 3:30 PM (back-to-back infra standups). If having Ben (security) present at the tech session is critical, I'd prefer Wed 1/17 9:00–9:40 AM PST so we can have a full cross-functional conversation.

If we must keep Tue evening for Ben, I can prepare a focused 20-minute demo + stay on the call for Q&A (or record the demo and join at the tail end). Also attaching the SOC2 summary we typically share so procurement has something to review ahead of the compliance session: SOC2-summary-2027.pdf (see attached).

Following the thread, I scheduled two events and sent invites separately so both teams get the right calendar items:

- Procurement & compliance: Fri 1/19 11:00–11:30 AM PST — invite sent to procurement@atlashealth.com
